newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Helicopters rescue Russian fishermen adrift on ice.
newsitem.headline: Helicopters rescue Russian fishermen adrift on ice.

text.p: Helicopters rescued 36 Russians set adrift on Thursday when the ice they were fishing on broke away from the shore of a lake near the border with Finland, the emergencies ministry said.

A ministry spokesman in St. Petersburg said rescue workers had defied strong winds and snow to pluck the fishermen from the ice of Lake Ladoga, about 30 km (20 miles) northeast of the city at its closest point.
The alarm was raised by other fishermen who managed to jump onto the shore as the ice broke away.
"We saved all 36 people," the spokesman said, dismissing media reports that other fishermen were still unaccounted for.
Fishing through holes cut in the ice is popular in Russia, despite the risk of being set adrift.
